tasks.old_behavior: Authorization/Proxy-Authorization header unconditionally removed from every message, even those with user-provided Authorization headers. Messages without a cached auth would have their manually-set Authorization header stripped, causing authentication failure when SOUP_MESSAGE_DO_NOT_USE_AUTH_CACHE is set.
tasks.new_behavior: Authorization/Proxy-Authorization header only removed when soup_message_get_auth(msg) returns non-NULL, i.e., when the message already has an associated SoupAuth from cached credentials. User-provided Authorization headers on messages without cached auth are preserved, allowing manual authentication to succeed.
tasks.compatibility_reason: This change may cause behaviors observable to applications that rely on Authorization headers not being preserved when no cached credentials exist (to trigger 401 challenges for cache-less re-authentication). The new behavior allows user-provided headers to survive even without cached credentials.
tasks.test_recommendation: 建议使用带有手动Authorization头的请求进行回归测试:在已认证session中，清除credentials缓存后，用soup_message_headers_replace设置Authorization头且设置SOUP_MESSAGE_DO_NOT_USE_AUTH_CACHE标志发送消息，验证Authorization头被保留且服务器正确响应。这是commit中新增的测试覆盖场景。
